title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals and groups adopt mask-wearing over time under social influence, policies, enforcement, supply constraints, and information campaigns.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: People influence each other’s mask use through social ties, observing peers and receiving messages.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Household-level norms and resources affect members’ adoption and mask sharing.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies through monitoring, penalties, or denial of service.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: People buy masks from retailers subject to price and inventory constraints.

interactions.name: government_policy
interactions.description: Government sets mandates, subsidies, and free distribution that alter compliance incentives.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: Media and government campaigns change perceived risk and norms; misinformation can lower adoption.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Epidemiological prevalence signals increase or decrease perceived risk, affecting adoption.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of people wearing masks at least once in a time step or average compliance across contexts.

metrics.name: context_specific_compliance
metrics.description: Mask-wearing rates by context (workplace, retail, transit, etc.).

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days until overall adoption surpasses a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption
metrics.description: Average adoption over a specified steady-state window (e.g., last 30 days).

metrics.name: policy_impact_delta
metrics.description: Difference in adoption before and after mandate/campaign interventions.

metrics.name: equity_gap
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates across demographic or socioeconomic groups.

metrics.name: purchase_rate
metrics.description: Number of masks purchased per capita per day.

metrics.name: enforcement_events
metrics.description: Count of penalties or denial-of-service events due to non-compliance.
